title: Aromatic Crisp Croatian Pork Skewers
description: A low-calorie, mustardy, and crisp Croatian dish perfect for brunch, featuring coco sugar and broiled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coco sugar, Dijon mustard, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a broiler pan lined with aluminum foil and broil for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
